surface.message: Evidence aggregation timed out under concurrent read fanout; degraded empty response returned.

proven_root_causes.cause: GET /bff/management/evidence and GET /bff/management/evidence/{ref_id} invoked run_management_read(_do_read) without a route-specific timeout_seconds argument, falling back to the generic 0.6s _management_read_timeout_seconds() budget even though DefaultResearchKnowledgeSourcePort._default_http_get bounds source-ingest owner HTTP reads at 2.0s and a healthy bounded 20-row page + 518-row SQL population summary read takes 491-612ms on Dev. Any read taking 601-612ms was cut off at 600ms as read_timeout.
proven_root_causes.repair: Introduce evidence-local _get_management_evidence_read_timeout() (defaulting to evidence_owner_read_timeout_seconds() + 0.5s = 2.5s, overridable via PANTHEON_BFF_EVIDENCE_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS and respecting explicit PANTHEON_BFF_MANAGEMENT_READ_TIMEOUT_SECONDS overrides) and wire it into bff_management_evidence and bff_management_evidence_detail without increasing the global management read timeout.

proven_root_causes.cause: _default_http_get used a fixed 2.0s socket timeout without consulting remaining_management_read_budget, _read_owner_evidence_page did not abort when management_read_deadline had already expired, and read_evidence_refs filtered service_client and fallback rows with raw tenant_id (None when invoked from ManagementService.get_evidence) instead of effective_tenant resolved from selected_tenant.
proven_root_causes.repair: Bound _default_http_get socket timeout to remaining_management_read_budget(evidence_owner_read_timeout_seconds()) and abort immediately when the deadline is exhausted; check remaining_management_read_budget() in _read_owner_evidence_page; propagate effective_tenant to selected_tenant when needed and enforce _record_matches_tenant(..., effective_tenant) across paged, fallback, and single-item evidence reads.

proven_root_causes.cause: _management_evidence_degraded_payload called _management_evidence_summary(filtered_total=0, page_items=[], redacted_count=0) with unavailable=False, causing route timeouts to fabricate a zero dataset (total_evidence: 0, verified_count: 0, by_source_type: {}) and router.py stamped every exception as reason='read_timeout'.
proven_root_causes.repair: Pass unavailable=True in _management_evidence_degraded_payload so degraded/timed-out responses report null summary counts (total_evidence: null, verified_count: null, by_source_type: null) and unavailable evidence_refs/knowledge_evidence surfaces, and distinguish ManagementReadTimeout (read_timeout / timeout_fallback), ManagementReadSaturated (read_capacity_saturated / capacity_fallback), and unexpected errors (read_error / error_fallback).
